question: Can you help me find the top 5 countries whose players have the highest average of their individual average runs per match across all seasons? Specifically, for each player, calculate their average runs per match over all matches they played, then compute the average of these player averages for each country, and include these country batting averages in the result.

prediction.sql:
WITH player_match_runs AS (
    SELECT
      bbb.striker AS player_id,
      bbb.match_id,
      SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0)) AS runs_in_match
    FROM ball_by_ball bbb
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs
      ON bbb.match_id = bs.match_id
     AND bbb.over_id = bs.over_id
     AND bbb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
     AND bbb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE bbb.striker IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bbb.striker, bbb.match_id
  ),
  player_avg AS (
    SELECT
      pmr.player_id,
      SUM(pmr.runs_in_match) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT pmr.match_id) AS avg_runs_per_match
    FROM player_match_runs pmr
    GROUP BY pmr.player_id
  )
  SELECT
    p.country_name,
    AVG(pa.avg_runs_per_match) AS country_batting_average
  FROM player_avg pa
  JOIN player p
    ON p.player_id = pa.player_id
  GROUP BY p.country_name
  ORDER BY country_batting_average DESC
  LIMIT 5;

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH player_runs AS (
  SELECT b.striker AS player_id,
         b.match_id,
         SUM(COALESCE(s.runs_scored,0)) AS runs
  FROM ball_by_ball b
  LEFT JOIN batsman_scored s
    ON b.match_id=s.match_id AND b.over_id=s.over_id AND b.ball_id=s.ball_id AND b.innings_no=s.innings_no
  GROUP BY b.striker, b.match_id
),
player_avg AS (
  SELECT player_id, AVG(runs) AS avg_runs_per_match
  FROM player_runs
  GROUP BY player_id
)
SELECT p.country_name,
       AVG(pa.avg_runs_per_match) AS country_batting_avg
FROM player_avg pa
JOIN player p ON p.player_id = pa.player_id
GROUP BY p.country_name
ORDER BY country_batting_avg DESC
LIMIT 5;
